iot.title: IoT Devices
iot.subtitle: Manage your Internet of Things devices
iot.no_devices_hint: Add your first device to get started.
iot.no_devices_filter_hint: Try changing the filter or add your first device to get started.
iot.ssh_unreachable_hint: Node sends heartbeats but inbound connections fail — self-heal in progress
iot.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete {name}?
iot.confirm_delete_body: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? This cannot be undone.
iot.join_energy_hint: Join a P2P energy cell to share solar energy with neighbors

device_form.identifier_help: Must match the identifier your tracker sends (for a phone — the ID from the Traccar Client app)
device_form.tracker_phone_hint: Phone as a tracker: install the Traccar Client app (Android/iOS), set the server URL to {url} and copy the device identifier from the app into the field above.
device_form.tracker_hw_hint: Hardware tracker: server {host}, port by protocol (GT06 5023 · Teltonika 5027 · H02 5013), identifier = IMEI.

validation.name_min: Name must contain at least 2 characters
validation.name_max: Name cannot be longer than 100 characters

iot.host_pass_hint: This node keeps your mesh pass covered while it stays online — full speed on every Parahub node. Open the guest portal to enable it on your devices.
iot.role_manager_hint: Can configure the device (WiFi, VPN, location), but not delete or share it
iot.role_viewer_hint: Can see the device, its status and telemetry
iot.transfer_desc: The new owner gets full control of this device.
iot.claim_entry_desc: Got a pre-configured Parahub router? Link it to your account with the MAC address from its sticker
iot.claim_intro: Type the MAC address printed on the router sticker to prove it is in your hands.
iot.claim_mac_hint: 12 characters from the label — colons optional
iot.claim_not_found: No router with this MAC. The label may show several addresses — try the others, and make sure the router has been powered on at least once.
iot.claim_already_yours: This router is already in your device list.
iot.claim_already_owned: This router is already attached to another account. Ask its owner to transfer it to you.
iot.claim_rate_limited: Too many attempts — try again later
iot.claim_rate_limited_in: Too many attempts — try again in {min} min
iot.claim_bad_mac: That does not look like a MAC address

wizard.title: Add a device
wizard.pick_tracker_desc: Scooter, car, bike or a phone — live position on the map
wizard.pick_network_desc: A Parahub network node: Wi-Fi, guest network, neighbourhood connectivity
wizard.pick_station_desc: Weather and air quality — your data on the shared map
wizard.pick_object_desc: House, apartment or land — devices attach to it
wizard.tracker_phone_desc: The Traccar Client app turns a phone into a GPS tracker
wizard.tracker_hw_desc: A GPS module with a SIM card: GT06, Teltonika, H02 and others
wizard.traccar_about: Traccar — the open-source GPS platform these trackers talk to
wizard.network_variant_title: How do you want to add a router?
wizard.network_claim_desc: The router already runs our firmware — claim it by the sticker MAC address
wizard.network_flash_desc: Build firmware for a supported model on the Mesh page
wizard.station_ag_desc: Air-quality monitor — polled automatically through the mesh network
wizard.station_eco_desc: Ecowitt weather stations (WS series and compatible) — pushes over Wi-Fi
wizard.phone_step1: Install the Traccar Client app (Android or iOS)
wizard.phone_step2: In the app settings, set the server URL:
wizard.phone_step3: Copy the device identifier from the app into the field below
wizard.identifier_hint: The "device identifier" field on the Traccar Client main screen
wizard.imei_hint: 15 digits — on the device sticker or the box
wizard.serial_hint: The MAC address from the device sticker, e.g. d83bda1ac64c
wizard.hw_configure_intro: Set these in the tracker via SMS commands or the vendor app:
wizard.phone_verify_hint: Open Traccar Client and start tracking — the position will appear here
wizard.eco_configure_intro: In the WS View Plus app: your station → Customized, Ecowitt protocol:
wizard.ag_configure_title: Join the monitor to the mesh network
wizard.ag_configure_body: Connect the AirGradient to a Parahub router's Wi-Fi — the station is discovered automatically by serial number and polled every 3 minutes.
wizard.generic_note: This station type has no automated setup — data is wired up individually.
wizard.wait_hint_tracker: Usually under a minute after tracking starts
wizard.wait_hint_ag: Usually up to 5 minutes after joining the Wi-Fi
wizard.wait_hint_eco: Data arrives after the first upload interval

iot.device_not_found_hint: It may have been deleted, or shared access was revoked.
iot.section_access_help: The credentials this router hands out. Show the QR code to a guest and their phone joins the private WiFi without typing anything.
iot.wifi_credentials_help: Name and password of your own network — the one your devices use, isolated from the free guest network.
iot.wifi_qr_hint: Point a phone camera at the code to join.
iot.wifi_qr_aria: QR code that joins the private WiFi
iot.root_credentials_help: For SSH or the LuCI web interface on the router itself. Only needed for advanced troubleshooting.
iot.wifi_settings_help: Rename the private network or set a new password. Keep both the same on every router of yours, or seamless roaming between them stops working.
iot.wifi_reveal_failed: Could not read the password from the router
iot.root_reveal_failed: Could not read the password from the router
iot.wifi_save_failed: Could not save the WiFi settings
iot.section_network_help: How much of this connection the mesh may use, and which way the traffic leaves.
iot.section_vpn_help: Guest traffic never leaves through your own IP address. Here you choose which tunnel carries it.
iot.section_location_help: Where the node stands. The point appears on the public coverage map; your name only if you turn that on below.
iot.section_telemetry_help: What the router reported over the last day or week: traffic through the uplink, connected clients, and whether it kept reporting at all.
iot.telemetry_empty: No data yet — the router reports every 5 minutes, and older firmware sends none at all.
iot.section_diagnostics_help: Live output of the diagnostic commands, straight from the router. Handy to copy into a support request.
iot.section_sharing_help: Who else can see and manage this device. A viewer only looks; a manager can change settings but cannot delete it or share it further.
iot.section_settings_help: The name you see in the list, what the public map may say about it, and removal.
iot.show_owner_label: Show me as the owner on the map
iot.show_owner_help: By default the node appears on the public map without a name. Turn this on to be named as its host.
iot.show_owner_on: Your name is shown next to this node
iot.show_owner_off: The node is on the map, you are not named
iot.delete_help: Removes the device from your account. The hardware keeps running and can be claimed again by its MAC address.
iot.firmware_update_help: Routers update themselves overnight — nothing to do here.
iot.how_private_wifi: Your private WiFi (WPA3) is isolated from everything else. All your routers share one network name and password, so devices roam between them without dropping.
iot.how_guest_wifi: The open parahub.io/free network is for guests and neighbours: capped speed, no access to your own network, and its traffic leaves through a VPN tunnel rather than your home IP.
iot.how_mesh: Routers find each other over radio and pass traffic along. A node without its own internet connection borrows one from a neighbouring node.
iot.how_updates: New firmware installs itself at night, and the settings on this page survive the update.
iot.err_timeout: The router did not answer in time
iot.err_timeout_setup: Setup timed out — the network restart may still be running
iot.section_location_help_reported: The last position the device reported.
iot.delete_help_generic: Removes the device from your account.
iot.section_settings_help_generic: The name you see in the list, and removal.
iot.diagnostics_empty: The router answered, but reported nothing for this tab.
iot.section_passport_help: Addresses and identifiers for this device — what you paste into an SSH client or quote to support.
iot.section_activity_help: Who did what on this device, and with which role. Everyone with access sees the same list.
iot.activity_empty: Nothing has been done to this device yet.
iot.activity_footnote: Recorded automatically. Values are never stored — only which fields were touched.
